source_text: In contemporary public health, the World Health Organization endorsed voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) in 2007 for high-HIV-prevalence regions in sub-Saharan Africa, citing randomized trials showing 50–60% reduction in heterosexual acquisition risk, leading to over 30 million procedures by 2023 in 15 priority countries to curb epidemics where prevalence exceeds 10%. [34]
